build_commands.name: rust-release
build_commands.command: cache_dir=/home/isucon/.cache/isucon-cargo-target; input_marker=$cache_dir/.replace-with-binary-name-build-input; compiler_marker=$cache_dir/.replace-with-binary-name-rustc-version; sudo install -d -o isucon -g isucon -m 0755 "$cache_dir"; if ! sudo test -f "$cache_dir/.rustc_info.json" && sudo test -d "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_REMOTE_PATH/target"; then sudo -u isucon cp -a "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_REMOTE_PATH/target/." "$cache_dir/"; fi; cached_input_id=$(sudo cat "$input_marker" 2>/dev/null || true); compiler_id=$(sudo -u isucon rustc -V); cached_compiler_id=$(sudo cat "$compiler_marker" 2>/dev/null || true); if test "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_BUILD_INPUTS_UNCHANGED" != true || test "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_BUILD_INPUT_ID" != "$cached_input_id" || ! sudo test -x "$cache_dir/release/replace-with-binary-name" || test "$compiler_id" != "$cached_compiler_id"; then cd "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_STAGING_PATH"; sudo -u isucon env CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$cache_dir" cargo build --release --locked; sudo -u isucon sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "$1" > "$2"; exec rustc -V > "$3"' sh "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_BUILD_INPUT_ID" "$input_marker" "$compiler_marker"; fi; sudo -u isucon install -D -m 0755 "$cache_dir/release/replace-with-binary-name" "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_STAGING_PATH/target/release/replace-with-binary-name"; test -x "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_STAGING_PATH/target/release/replace-with-binary-name"
